summary: This Church lecture adds high-pressure but workflow-only accounting for the Church as spiritual empire: Rome's failed bureaucracy gives way to a Church that claims jurisdiction over heaven, makes doctrine administrable, sells salvation as paperwork, and answers legitimacy crises through crusade, scapegoat, inquisition, and miracle.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as future evidence for the already-public institution-outside-history mechanism: the Church claims to be a divine empire outside ordinary historical competition, where kings rule land but the Church decides heaven and hell.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Eschatology owns the sacred institution escaping historical judgment and governing present action through heaven, hell, and final order. It should not become a generic Catholic Church, Crusades, or medieval Europe page.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold this source as the medieval Catholic hardening layer for administrative filter: Christianity starts as a franchise model, Constantine and Nicaea require one orthodoxy, the creed becomes memorized formula, and authorized interpretation turns access to truth and salvation into an office-centered code.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Religion As Administrative Filter owns the code that selects, disciplines, and authorizes priests, bishops, believers, and interpreters. Eschatology owns the outside-history claim; Bureaucracy owns later procedure and record power.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use as bounded future evidence for religious bureaucracy when spiritual authority becomes land, tax exemption, simony, indulgence, relic sales, excommunication procedure, and Inquisition investigation.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Bureaucracy owns office self-preservation, institutional extraction, and searchable procedure. It should not absorb the whole source because the lecture's first-order mechanism is sacred jurisdiction.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Keep Charlemagne, papal anointing, and the competition for Rome's legacy as bounded legitimacy-fiction pressure: rulers and warlords need Church recognition to make post-Roman power feel chosen by God.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Legitimacy Fiction owns the recognition and useful-fiction layer. It should not become the home for doctrine, salvation jurisdiction, scapegoating, or church procedure.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Hold as future taboo evidence only where the source is about displaced guilt and marked targets: the Church's legitimacy crises are answered by Jewish scapegoating, Crusade demonization, and violence that lets salvation and social anger travel through an enemy body.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Taboo owns scapegoat routing and sacrificial violence. Religion owns authorized orthodoxy; Eschatology owns sacred role-script; Bureaucracy owns Inquisition procedure.

concept_extensions.proposed_addition: Use only as comparison pressure for agency capture: the Church tries to trap the divine spark by naming it demonic, educating dissenters back into obedience, and punishing those who refuse to surrender inner truth.
concept_extensions.boundary_note: Free Will owns inner agency against institutional obedience. The source should stay outside Free Will unless a later public pass compares Jesus, Paul, Grand Inquisitor, Cathars, and Dante as one agency-capture sequence.

new_lens_seeds.title: Spiritual Empire Sells Salvation Jurisdiction
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A religious institution can outlast political empire by claiming the higher jurisdiction: the state may kill the body, but the Church claims to decide the soul, then converts that jurisdiction into doctrine, office, taxation, indulgence, excommunication, crusade, and inquisition.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The mechanism can compare Catholic Church, Paul/Augustine, Holy Roman Empire, Protestant rupture, AI salvation interfaces, and any institution that moves itself outside ordinary failure by controlling the path to final safety.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a seed only. Do not create standalone Church Empire, Empire Of Church, Spiritual Empire, Salvation Jurisdiction, Catholic Church, Augustine, Indulgences, Inquisition, or Crusades pages from this source alone.

new_lens_seeds.title: Prophet Message Becomes Empire
new_lens_seeds.core_mechanism: A liberating messenger can open access to the divine spark, but later administrators preserve the messenger's words while turning them into empire, orthodoxy, hierarchy, and obedience.
new_lens_seeds.why_reusable: The source explicitly makes this a sequence across Jesus, Muhammad, Zoroaster, Homer, and Paul, and it can later help compare Guide Trap, Free Will, Religion As Administrative Filter, Poetry, and Legitimacy Fiction.
new_lens_seeds.boundary_note: Hold as a comparison seed only; it is too broad for a public page from this source alone and overlaps existing Paul, Guide Trap, Free Will, and Poetry pressure.

chronology_notes.note: Dated 2025-12-04, this Secret History lecture restates and broadens the outside-history Church mechanism later/publicly carried by the Eschatology page: Augustine/Paul make the Church a spiritual empire where worldly defeat cannot judge sacred authority.
